key_insight: HISPO improves long-form mathematical reasoning by assigning reinforcement-learning credit at the segment level, bridging the gap between token-level and sequence-level importance-sampling corrections.
engineering_relevance: For RLVR systems, segment-level updates offer a practical middle ground that can better handle credit assignment in long solutions without collapsing to overly fine or overly coarse optimization granularity.
method: Builds contiguous segments from rollout-time entropy signals.
Assigns soft saliency weights based on segment entropy.
Applies clipped importance-sampling correction at the segment level.
evidence_signal: Fine-tuning Qwen3-1.7B-Base on six math benchmarks, HISPO improved Pass@8 on all benchmarks and matched or exceeded the strongest baseline in Acc@8 on five, including gains on AIME25 over GRPO and GSPO.
watch_item: Segment construction depends on entropy-derived boundaries and weighting, so performance may be sensitive to segmentation heuristics and implementation details.
paper_title: HISPO: Hierarchical Importance-Sampling Policy Optimization with Entropy-Derived Segments
